authority: Independent assistant source audit, not human gold; no accuracy percentage is derived.

assessments.claim: All three frozen files belong to the workflow and the YAML omission rules apply to the same search call.
assessments.support: All three source hashes match the independent inventory. Task R5/R7, processing merges ir_008/ir_012 and call ir_014 retain these citations and the same-call relationship.
assessments.limits: This checks use of the frozen supplied sources, not unseen runtime files or external service behavior.

assessments.claim: The represented workflow reads request.json, prepares query from request.term unchanged and has one search call coordinate.
assessments.support: ir_001 reads the whole request; ir_003 selects its term; every recorded argument object has query equal to that selected Data ID. ir_014 is the sole index.search call, with paired send/receive. The four alternatives are optional-argument cases, not four sequential calls.
assessments.limits: The at_most constraint is satisfied within the declared static model. No actual Skill execution or service success was measured.

assessments.claim: Optional presence and original values are separately represented; the saved request facts retain all four key combinations.
assessments.support: ir_005/ir_009 use present(field(request,...)); ir_006/ir_010 reuse the original field IDs. The final maps have exactly query; query/from_date; query/limit; or query/from_date/limit, each with its own predecessor bindings. No presence boolean is included in the tool payload.
assessments.unresolved: The R4/R6 only_if checks report potential_violation, explicitly without asserting feasibility or execution. Unknown concrete values and valid reference compilation do not prove all constraint outcomes. No concrete null-valued request was executed.

assessments.claim: Fuzzy capability and accepted date format do not become extra processing or payload.
assessments.support: Task and selected graph retain the distinction. The saved argument maps contain only query and the two optional fields; there is no fuzzy flag, normalization, date replacement, validation or rejection operation.
assessments.limits: No assertion is made that an unknown supplied date meets YYYY-MM-DD or that the external tool accepts every supplied value.

assessments.claim: The no-index.delete restriction remains source-grounded, but its global formal compliance is not established.
assessments.support: Task R8 and the CFG retain the prohibition; no index.delete operation or delivery is present in the saved workflow.
assessments.unresolved: The selected R8 realization is retained_only with no applicable demand goal or supported constraint and a stated missing-event-target gap. Both global blocking DOE diagnostics refer to R8. Absence of a represented delete operation is not promoted to proof of global compliance.

assessments.claim: Each saved count is the selected total of the response whose unchanged items are returned.
assessments.support: For all four request alternatives, ir_016 and ir_018 select total and items from the identical received response ID with identical predecessor bindings. ir_017 writes only the total ID, with replace as the declared default; ir_019 retains only the items input. The write has no public output and the return emits no invented user delivery.
assessments.limits: No concrete total or items content, byte serialization, or external filesystem execution is established.

assessments.claim: The run does not invent sensitivity categories or a user-facing return sink.
assessments.support: Sensitivity declarations and sensitive-data reviews are empty, consistent with source lacking a concrete sensitive category. Fourteen model-observe positions remain as shared-contract possibilities; one search sink and one count storage sink complete the sixteen sink positions. The ordinary return only retains its actual CFG input.
assessments.limits: Unknown term/items may contain sensitive content. Zero declared-range comparisons do not establish nonsensitivity, safety, minimality, or absence of DOE.
